senses.gloss: m. (= תרי קב) [two Kabs; later] three Kabs, a dry measure (v. Herzfeld, Metrol. Voruntersuch. II, p. 63 sq.); also a field requiring a Tarḳab of seed.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Ma'asrot 2:7">Tosef. Maasr. II, 7</cite> <he>בינונית אינה פחותה מת׳ וכ׳</he> a medium size basket is no less than a Tarḳab, a small one no less than two Kabs; (differ. in Y. ib. II, 49ᶜ bot.).
<cite ref="Mishnah Tamid 5:4">Tam. V, 4</cite> <he>והכף דומה לת׳ גדול וכ׳</he> the spoon (for frankincense) resembled a large Tarḳab …, containing three Kabs.

<cite ref="Niddah 49b:21">Nidd. 49ᵇ</cite> <he>או ת׳ וישב עליו</he> or if he inverted a T. and sat on it; <cite ref="Shabbat 59a:3">Sabb. 59ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Chagigah 23b:5">Ḥag. 23ᵇ</cite> (not <cite ref="P00794"><he>עליה</he></cite>).
<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Berakhot 1:1:23">Y. Ber. I, 2ᶜ</cite> bot., v. <cite ref="V00702"><he>תַּמְצִית</he></cite>; a. fr.
